draft.letter_text: Dear GymCo, I am writing to dispute the direct debit of $24.99 on [date] as I had cancelled my membership. I would appreciate it if you could investigate this matter and provide a refund or credit to my account. Please confirm in writing once this matter has been resolved. Sincerely, [Your Name]
steps: Check your bank statement for the disputed transaction
Contact GymCo's customer service to explain the situation
Request a refund or credit to your account
Escalate to Your bank's dispute team if GymCo does not resolve the issue
Escalate to Merchant support if Your bank's dispute team cannot assist
Ask the merchant — or your bank — to remove the direct-debit authority. Cancelling the subscription alone does not stop direct-debit payments.
